title: PWM Generator (Multilevel)
text: Generate pulse width modulated signal or waveform for modular multilevel converters, 1 input, 1 output; {Converter topology} sets the modular multilevel converter topology, {Number of power submodules} sets the number of modular multilevel submodules, {Timer period (s)} sets the pWM period and {Sample time} sets the block sample time 5e-5. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Converter topology
params.values: Modular multilevel converter topology Half-bridge (default) | Full-bridge

params.name: Number of power submodules
params.values: Number of modular multilevel submodules 1 (default) | positive scalar
